hypothesis: Episode cue memory with reward-based local association predicts delayed choice, compared against equally informed one-bit conventional learner.
learning: Retain episode early cue once; FIT selected actual candidate+reward updates Beta Bernoulli counts for match vs mismatch. No hidden success label. Reward updates only selected physical action outcome; persistent state survives cold restart.
prior: K5A R3 engineered causal planning tied conventional online planner. This is independent memory problem, not another renamed planner.
public_data: Actual original MemoryEnv full grid seen ONLY by the shared route executor and phase-specific cue/branch extractor. Policy sees early cue token at phase 1 and two branch candidate tokens at phase 2, not earlier cue again. No environment success_pos API.
tests: No memory before episode, trained real binary feedback and cold restore, invalid feedback atomic, missing cue ablation, same FIT conventional baseline.
